name: sentry
description: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
one_liner: A tool that tells developers exactly why their app or website crashed, with the trace to fix it fast, instead of digging through server logs.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small SaaS company who needs to know about and fix production bugs before customers complain.
business_use_cases: A startup self-hosts it to monitor their production app without the cost of the hosted enterprise plan.
An agency offers managed Sentry setup and monitoring as part of their app-maintenance retainer for small-business clients.
A vertical SaaS builds a simplified, pre-configured error dashboard on top of it for a specific platform (e.g. Shopify app developers).

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed self-hosted Sentry service for startups who don't want to run their own ops, billed monthly.
Sell a one-off 'production health checkup' using it to diagnose a client's existing app issues.

steal_this: This weekend, stand up a self-hosted Sentry instance pre-configured for Shopify/WooCommerce apps and offer it as a $29/month add-on to small e-commerce dev shops.
